question: Sarah bought 8 new shirts for school. If she already had 9 shirts, how many did she own total?
Carol was helping her mom plant vegetables in the garden. Together they planted 6 rows of potatoes with 9 seeds in each row. How many potatoes did they plant total?
Ned was buying books about astronomy. He bought 8 books about the planets and 4 about the space program. How many books did he buy total?
Rachel had to complete 9 pages of math homework and 2 pages of reading homework. How many pages did she have to complete total?
An industrial machine can make 6 shirts every minute. How many shirts would it have made in 6 minutes?
Haley collected 9 cans for recycling. If she put 7 cans in one bag, how many cans did she have left?
Amy was buying different soups. She bought 6 cans of chicken soup and 3 cans of tomato soup. How many soups did she buy?
Adam was reading through his favorite book series. The first week he read 5 different books. The next week he read 8 books. How many books did he read total?
Isabel received 14 dollars for her birthday. Later she found some toys that cost 2 dollars each. How many of the toys could she buy?
There are 30 students in a class. If the teacher put them into groups with 5 students in each group, how many groups would she have?
There are 40 students in the school band. If the band instructor put the students into rows with 5 students in each row, how many rows could he make?
Robin bought 11 sodas for her and her friends. If they only drank 3 of them, how many extras did she have?
An architect was building his two story house. On the first floor the house had 6 bedrooms and the second floor had 4 bedrooms. How many bedrooms does the house have totaled?
A designer was buying furniture for her new house. She bought 3 chairs for the living room and 6 for her kitchen. How many chairs did she buy total?
A pet store had 4 snakes. They had the snakes in cages with 2 snakes in each cage. How many cages did the pet store have?
A contractor was buying wall outlets for a new house he was building. Each room needed 6 outlets. If the house has 7 rooms, how many outlets does he need total?
A pet store took ten birds out of a cage and had nine still left inside. How many birds were in the cage to start with?
Paige raised fifteen goldfish in the pond but stray cats loved eating them. Now she has four left. How many goldfish disappeared?
Cody cooked fourteen dumplings. He ate seven. How many dumplings does Cody have now?
Debby had twelve pieces of candy. After eating some, she had three pieces. How many pieces did Debby eat?
Robin's hair was fifteen inches long. If she cut off five inches, how long is her hair now?
A chef had sixteen apples. After making a pie he had seven left. How many apples did he use in the pie?
The book fair sold four posters. Now they have two posters left. How many posters did they have to begin with?
Ned ordered some pizzas for a party. During the party four were eaten. Now he has seven left. How many pizzas did Ned order for the party?
Jerry had $18. He spent $6 on new video games. How much money does he have now?
